# Character sheet: <name>

One page, stage 1 and 2 of [`../preproduction-workflow.md`](../preproduction-workflow.md). Adult characters only, age stated.

## Story (stage 1)
- Name, role in the plot, archetype, route
- Age: <18 or more>
- Want, need, defining contradiction, what she hides
- Voice: five tics, three lines she would never say, how she addresses the lead
- Relations: what she knows about the others
- Arc by chapter: one line per rung of the ladder

## Look (stage 2, locked by the owner)
Labelled lines, one per field: `node scripts/pipeline-gates.mjs sheet <file>` fails while one is missing or still a `<...>`.
- Height: <cm, e.g. 168 cm>
- Measurements: <bust / waist / hips in cm>
- Base body and preset: <base, preset and slider values>
- Silhouette numbers: <girth and gap at the heights the style sheet names; the gate's silhouette row checks these>
- Hair: <colour by comparison, length, texture>; eye colour; distinguishing marks
- Palette: <3 to 5 colours>; signature outfit, work, casual and night looks
- Expression list (which of the shared set she uses)
- Reference picture path and turnaround

## Approval
- Look-Lock: <owner card link> · <YYYY-MM-DD>
Then a change log (one line per change after the lock: what, why, assets reopened).
